1.
Heard Sri Atul Bhushan Pandey, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as Sri Rajeev Singh, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. This is the second bail application.
First bail application got rejected by this Court vide order dated 10.10.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.11179 of 2021.

sentences.text:
3. The present bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C.has been filed seeking bail in F.I.R. No. 351 of 2021,
under Sections 500, 504, 506, 376 I.P.C. and Sections 66A, 66C and 66E of the Information Technology Act, Police Station Thakurganj, District Lucknow.
4. The allegation in the F.I.R. against the accused-applicant was sending the nude and objectionable photographs and videos of the prosecutrix on Whatsapp of the parents of the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: prosecutrix in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has stated that accused-applicant got befriended with her on Instagram and the accused-applicant developed friendship with the prosecutrix.
One day, the accused-applicant took the prosecutrix to a hotel and gave some intoxicated drinks and thereafter committed rape on her and made her nude video-graphs.

When the prosecutrix refused to subject herself to her wishes, the accused-applicant uploaded her video-graphs on the website which is mentioned in the F.I.R.
5.
However, during the examination, the prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution case and she has been declared as hostile.
6. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that this Court may put any condition as a condition precedent for granting bail without prejudice to the rights and contention in the trial.
Accused-applicant has been in jail since 27.6.2021.
7. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail, but not disputed the aforesaid facts.
8. Considering the above facts and circumstances of the case and the stand of the prosecutrix in the Court, it would be appropriate to enlarge the accused-applicant on bail.

9. Let applicant Mohd. Adil Mirza be released on bail in the above case crime number on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned with the following conditions :-
(i) The accused-applicant shall report at Police Station Thakurganj, District Lucknow on every 15th day of the month till the trial gets concluded.
The accused-applicant shall not ever try to establish any contact with the prosecutrix either personally or by any electronic /social media and he will never meet the prosecutrix in future.
(ii) The accused-applicant file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

(iii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed,
either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then the trial court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.
